sounds.name: right
sounds.when: The green sheet comes up after a right answer. The most-heard reward sound, and the one every other reward is built from.
sounds.credit: Not prescribed word-for-word by Google. CC BY 4.0 requires credit + licence notice, e.g. "Sounds from Material Design sound resources by Google, licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)" and an indication if the sounds were modified.

sounds.name: not-right
sounds.when: The “not quite” sheet comes up. The app never says “wrong”, so this must not sound like a buzzer or a punishment.
sounds.credit: Not prescribed word-for-word on the page. CC BY 4.0 requires author credit + licence, e.g. "UI Utility Pack Vol 1 by JC Sounds (https://opengameart.org/content/jc-sounds-ui-utility-pack-vol-1), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)".

sounds.name: pick
sounds.when: You pick an answer tile, a picture or a word. Heard many times in every lesson, so it has to be small.
sounds.credit: Not prescribed word-for-word by Google. CC BY 4.0 requires credit + licence notice, e.g. "Sounds from Material Design sound resources by Google, licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)" and an indication if the sounds were modified.

sounds.name: tile
sounds.when: A word tile lands in the sentence line in Tile Builder. Each next tile plays one step higher.

sounds.name: combo
sounds.when: The full-screen combo page at 3, 5 and 10 right answers in a row.

sounds.name: mic-on
sounds.when: You press the mic: a short sound right before it starts listening. Some options are a pair and play “on”, a pause, then “off” (listening ended).
sounds.credit: Not prescribed word-for-word on the page. CC BY 4.0 requires author credit + licence, e.g. "UI Utility Pack Vol 1 by JC Sounds (https://opengameart.org/content/jc-sounds-ui-utility-pack-vol-1), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)".

sounds.name: mic-off
sounds.when: You press the mic: a short sound right before it starts listening. Some options are a pair and play “on”, a pause, then “off” (listening ended).
sounds.credit: Not prescribed word-for-word on the page. CC BY 4.0 requires author credit + licence, e.g. "UI Utility Pack Vol 1 by JC Sounds (https://opengameart.org/content/jc-sounds-ui-utility-pack-vol-1), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)".

sounds.name: lesson-done
sounds.when: The lesson result screen, with the confetti.

sounds.name: perfect
sounds.when: A lesson with no mistakes: “Mukammal” slams in gold, rings and big confetti.

sounds.name: new-phrase
sounds.when: The violet “you can now say” card pops in with twinkles.

sounds.name: count
sounds.when: Numbers counting up, and the gold bits landing on a counter one by one.
sounds.credit: Not prescribed word-for-word on the page. CC BY 3.0 requires author credit + licence, e.g. "Fantasy Sound Effects Library by Little Robot Sound Factory (www.littlerobotsoundfactory.com), licensed under CC BY 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/)".

sounds.name: level-up
sounds.when: The level badge slams in and the number flips.

sounds.name: trophy
sounds.when: The checkpoint is finished: the trophy drops and lands.

sounds.name: award
sounds.when: A new award on the Profile page: the tile punches and gets its “YANGI” tag.
sounds.credit: "Some of the sounds in this project were created by David McKee (ViRiX) soundcloud.com/virix"

sounds.name: streak
sounds.when: The flame lights on the streak screen after the first lesson of the day.

sounds.name: freeze
sounds.when: A streak freeze is used: frost covers the flame.

sounds.name: button
sounds.when: The main button is pressed (TEKSHIRISH, DAVOM ETISH).

sounds.name: pop
sounds.when: Something small appears: a badge, a chip, a toast, a tag.

sounds.name: whoosh
sounds.when: A sheet slides up, a tile flies to the line, a screen changes. Optional: many apps leave this silent.

sounds.name: switch-on
sounds.when: A toggle is flipped in Settings. Each option plays “on”, a pause, then “off”.

sounds.name: switch-off
sounds.when: A toggle is flipped in Settings. Each option plays “on”, a pause, then “off”.

sounds.name: reminder
sounds.when: The daily reminder notification.
